name: Tartan
author: E. T. Carter
description: A dark tartan sett woven from light: translucent warp bands running vertical and weft bands running horizontal, crossing in an over-under weave so the overlaps brighten and whichever thread rides on top alternates square by square. The stripe recipe repeats across the frame and a slow shimmer breathes through it, colour following the band groups. Crossing bands of light, never filled cells.

params.label: Sett size
params.effect: Size of one repeat of the stripe recipe in CSS pixels — a busy fine plaid at the low end, a few big bold blocks at the high end.

params.label: Thread
params.effect: Size of the woven thread cells that set the over-under checker — a fine tight weave at the low end, a coarse chunky basket at the high end.

params.label: Weave depth
params.effect: How strongly the under-thread dims beneath the over-thread — a flat printed plaid at 0, a deep physical over-under weave at 1.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Band glow strength and the brightness of the crossings — a muted cloth at 0, a luminous backlit tartan at 1.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Amount of travelling brightness wave across the cloth — a static sett at 0, a rippling sheen at 1.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: Speed of the shimmer travelling diagonally through the weave — frozen at 0, briskly flowing at full.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far colour travels across the sett — a single tartan colourway near 0, a full spectral plaid at the high end.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole cloth off-square, from a level sett to a bias-cut diagonal plaid.

params.label: Blur
params.effect: Softness of the band edges — crisp woven threads at 0, a soft out-of-focus tartan at 1.

params.label: Background
params.effect: Brightness of the lit field behind the cloth — pure black at 0, a softly glowing backdrop at 1.
